Vincent J. Russo is the Legal Correspondent on CFN Live. He keeps you up-to-date on the latest legal developments including elder law, special needs, and estate planning -- all to help you make informed planning decisions to protect yourself, your loved ones, and your assets. In this appearance, Vincent J.
